company.description: The company's name. Required unless item is given.

item.description: The one company bound to this branch: a list-prepare slot {i, item_key, label, query} (fixed branches), a list-prepare accepted entry {index, item: {name, domain, ...}, item_key, query, queries?} (a for_each branch; the company is item.item), or a plain {name, domain?}. item_key is always top-level and copied unchanged into item_result.item_key. null = empty slot.

item_key.description: The stable identity key list-prepare gave this item; copied unchanged into item_result.item_key.

index.description: The accepted entry's slot index (for_each item).

item.description: In a list-prepare accepted entry: the company record as given, e.g. {name, domain}.

queries.description: Per-term queries of an accepted entry (list-prepare query_terms).

lookback_days.description: Window length in days, ending at now.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time. Never guessed.

context.description: What the reader sells or cares about; used only for why_it_matters.

rubric.description: Optional signals that count. When given, only events matching a signal are kept, and rubric_score = 10 x matched weight / total weight sets the verdict.

track_state.description: true for a scheduled watch: compare with the previous run's saved state (from a state read step), leave out events already reported, and return state_out and state_sheet_values.
